name: Imadoki Junjou Monogatari
source:
Main character falls from a cliff and awakens at a hospital will amnesia. With the care of Chizuru nurse he regains physical strength gradually. The two fall in love with each other. However, one day Chizuru goes missing. Protagonist stands up to find her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-april-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从悬崖上坠落，在医院醒来时失去了记忆。在护士Chizuru的照料下，他逐渐恢复了体力，两人也爱上了彼此。然而，某一天，Chizuru突然失踪。主人公于是动身寻找她。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-april-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
